description: This Java source file defines the AccountTransferTransaction entity class, which models transfer transactions between accounts such as savings and loans within the Finiract platform. It includes fields for linked transactions, transfer details, date, amount, and description, along with static factory methods for creating specific transfer types.

classes.name: AccountTransferTransaction
classes.description: Represents a transfer transaction between accounts, including savings and loan accounts, with fields for linked transactions, date, amount, currency, and description.
